name: OpenAtlas catalog
description: Curated directory of free APIs and open datasets. Every entry links to the original source and states pricing, access requirements, and usage limits. Curation rules: free to use, original source only, no duplicates, verified with a date.

resources.name: Open-Meteo
resources.description: Global weather forecasts, historical climate data, and air quality. Built for your next weather-powered project.
resources.limitation: Free for non-commercial use; usage limits apply.

resources.name: World Bank Open Data
resources.description: Economic, development, and population indicators from countries around the world.
resources.limitation: Check the license and attribution requirements of each dataset.

resources.name: NASA Open APIs
resources.description: Explore space with astronomy images, Earth observation, and data from NASA missions.
resources.limitation: A free API key is recommended; endpoint rate limits apply.

resources.name: REST Countries
resources.description: Country names, capitals, currencies, languages, and flags in one straightforward API.
resources.limitation: Community-operated service; no uptime guarantee.

resources.name: Open Library
resources.description: Millions of books, authors, editions, and cover images from the Internet Archive's open catalog.
resources.limitation: Use responsibly and follow the documented request limits.

resources.name: Data.gov
resources.description: Public US government datasets covering agriculture, cities, health, energy, and much more.
resources.limitation: Formats, licenses, and access vary by publisher.

resources.name: GBIF Biodiversity Data
resources.description: Open species observations and biodiversity records contributed by institutions worldwide.
resources.limitation: Bulk downloads require an account; individual dataset licenses vary.

resources.name: Open Food Facts
resources.description: A collaborative database of food products, ingredients, nutrition, and packaging information.
resources.limitation: ODbL attribution and share-alike conditions apply.

resources.name: National Weather Service
resources.description: Official US weather forecasts, active alerts, station observations, and gridded forecast data.
resources.limitation: Free for any purpose. Identify your application with a User-Agent and respect service rate limits.

resources.name: USGS Earthquake Catalog
resources.description: Search global earthquake events by location, time, magnitude, and depth, or use recent-event feeds.
resources.limitation: Use cached GeoJSON feeds for repeated real-time queries and follow documented query-size limits.

resources.name: Crossref Scholarly Metadata
resources.description: Find research publications, DOI records, funding information, licenses, and scholarly references.
resources.limitation: No sign-up required. Respect rate limits and identify requests; some abstracts have separate copyright restrictions.

resources.name: Eurostat Statistics API
resources.description: European population, employment, trade, energy, and economic indicators with programmatic downloads.
resources.limitation: Free programmatic access. Cite Eurostat and check reuse notices; the database provides current versions rather than a full version history.

resources.name: Wikidata Knowledge Graph
resources.description: Structured facts connecting people, places, organizations, works, and scientific concepts.
resources.limitation: Structured data is CC0. Public query services have execution and traffic limits; use bulk dumps for large workloads.

resources.name: OpenStreetMap Planet Data
resources.description: Download the global community map of roads, buildings, places, paths, and geographic features.
resources.limitation: ODbL attribution and share-alike obligations apply. Full planet downloads are large; regional extracts may be more practical.

resources.name: MusicBrainz Database
resources.description: Open music metadata for artists, albums, recordings, labels, genres, and their relationships.
resources.limitation: Core data is CC0; supplementary data has separate licensing. Commercial services and live replication feeds have additional terms.

resources.name: Transitous Journey Planning
resources.description: Community-operated public transport routing across multiple regions using open timetable feeds.
resources.limitation: For lightweight, non-commercial, open-source applications only. Identify your client, credit underlying sources, and follow the usage policy; no service guarantee.

resources.name: France Public Transit Data
resources.description: Open French transport feeds with stops, routes, scheduled departures, and selected real-time updates.
resources.limitation: This collection is filtered for open-license feeds. Check each publisher's attribution, update frequency, and real-time access conditions.

resources.name: Frankfurter Exchange Rates
resources.description: Currency reference rates and historical exchange data from central banks and official financial sources.
resources.limitation: No API key required. These are reference rates, not live market quotes; check the underlying providers' attribution and reuse terms.

resources.name: openFDA
resources.description: Search drug adverse events, product recalls, labeling, and other public FDA health records.
resources.limitation: A free API key is required by the current authentication guidance; request quotas apply. These records are not a substitute for medical advice.

resources.name: OSV Vulnerability API
resources.description: Look up known open-source vulnerabilities by package, version, commit, or vulnerability identifier.
resources.limitation: Check the licenses of contributing vulnerability databases. Large responses have protocol-dependent size limits; keep requests targeted.

resources.name: CISA Exploited Vulnerabilities
resources.description: Download a public catalog of security vulnerabilities known to have been exploited in the wild.
resources.limitation: Check the catalog's license and update date. Inclusion is evidence of known exploitation, not a complete inventory of all vulnerabilities.

resources.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
resources.description: Explore research datasets for classification, regression, clustering, and model evaluation.
resources.limitation: Dataset formats and licenses vary. Review each record's terms, citation requirements, and suitability before training a model.

resources.name: Common Crawl
resources.description: Public web crawl archives with page captures, metadata, and extracted text for large-scale research.
resources.limitation: Corpus access is free; processing and cloud compute can cost money. Crawled content retains its original rights and may contain personal data.

resources.name: CERN Open Data
resources.description: Particle physics research data from CERN experiments, with supporting analysis software and documentation.
resources.limitation: Products carry record-specific open licenses and citation requirements. Large datasets may require specialist software and substantial storage.

resources.name: DWD Open Weather Data
resources.description: German Weather Service observations, forecast products, radar information, and historical climate files.
resources.limitation: Read the server's README and product-specific reuse and attribution notices. Formats and update schedules vary by directory.

resources.name: MET Norway Weather API
resources.description: Forecasts and meteorological products from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute for locations worldwide.
resources.limitation: CC BY 4.0 attribution required. Identify your application, obey cache headers, and keep total application traffic below 20 requests per second unless agreed otherwise.

resources.name: Metropolitan Museum Collection
resources.description: Explore museum objects, artists, collection metadata, and images made available through The Met's open-access program.
resources.limitation: Check each object's public-domain and image rights status. Follow current API documentation and use the current paginated search endpoint.

resources.name: OpenAlex Research Graph
resources.description: Search connected scholarly works, authors, institutions, publication sources, and research topics.
resources.limitation: Public queries are free to start without a key. Higher-volume and additional features may require an account or paid access; verify current quotas.

resources.name: EIA Energy Data
resources.description: US and international energy time series covering electricity, petroleum, natural gas, renewables, and consumption.
resources.limitation: Register for a free API key. Follow EIA's API terms, reuse policy, and endpoint-specific response and request limits.

resources.name: US Treasury Fiscal Data
resources.description: Public debt, treasury statements, government spending, and other federal financial records with searchable metadata.
resources.limitation: Data is offered free for commercial and non-commercial use. Use pagination and filters, and check each table's update frequency and definitions.

resources.name: OpenFEC Campaign Finance
resources.description: Explore US election candidates, committees, campaign receipts, expenditures, and financial filings.
resources.limitation: A registered key allows 1,000 calls per hour and at most 100 results per page. Contributor lists may not be used to solicit donations or for commercial purposes.

resources.name: USDA FoodData Central
resources.description: Food composition and nutrient records for branded products, research foods, and dietary surveys.
resources.limitation: Free data.gov key required. Default limit: 1,000 requests per hour per IP; exceeding it can block the key for an hour. Data is CC0; source citation is requested.

resources.name: College Scorecard Data
resources.description: Download US college costs, enrollment, completion, student debt, repayment, and earnings data.
resources.limitation: Public bulk downloads need no API key. Read the data dictionary, reporting-year coverage, and privacy-suppression notes before comparisons.

resources.name: NOAA Tides & Currents
resources.description: Coastal station water levels, tide predictions, currents, and associated oceanographic observations.
resources.limitation: Data windows depend on interval: 1-minute observations allow 4 days per request, 6-minute observations 1 month, and hourly observations 1 year. Heavy query volumes may be throttled.

resources.name: NASA POWER
resources.description: Solar radiation and meteorological data tailored to renewable energy, agriculture, and building research.
resources.limitation: Free public datasets. Choose appropriate spatial and temporal endpoints, cite NASA POWER, and reduce request volume if the service returns HTTP 429.

resources.name: Our World in Data
resources.description: Download chart data on health, poverty, population, education, emissions, and long-term global change.
resources.limitation: OWID-produced material generally uses CC BY with attribution. Most underlying data comes from third parties and remains subject to their separate licenses.

resources.name: UK Government Open Data
resources.description: Public UK datasets covering local services, spending, transport, the environment, and government statistics.
resources.limitation: Licenses, file formats, and access conditions differ by publisher. Check each record rather than assuming the portal's Open Government Licence covers every linked dataset.

resources.name: GovData Germany
resources.description: Discover German federal, state, and municipal open data, including public administration and geographic records.
resources.limitation: The portal links to datasets hosted by individual publishers. Check the recorded license, attribution, download access, and freshness for each dataset.

resources.name: Research Organization Registry
resources.description: Persistent organization identifiers, names, locations, and relationships for research institutions around the world.
resources.limitation: No registration required. Maximum 2,000 requests per 5-minute period per IP address; use downloads or a local instance for larger workloads.

resources.name: DataCite Public Metadata
resources.description: Find DOI metadata for research datasets, software, and other scholarly outputs deposited by DataCite members.
resources.limitation: Public metadata retrieval needs no authentication. Creating or updating DOIs requires a member account; identify frequent scripted requests and respect pagination and service limits.

resources.name: TVmaze Public API
resources.description: Search television shows, episode guides, schedules, people, and cast information through a public catalog.
resources.limitation: The public API uses CC BY-SA: credit TVmaze and follow share-alike terms. At least 20 calls per 10 seconds per IP are normally allowed, but stricter temporary limits can apply. Premium user APIs are separate.

resources.name: Chess.com Published Data
resources.description: Read public player profiles, game archives, clubs, tournaments, and chess statistics.
resources.limitation: Read-only public records, not private account data. Make requests sequentially; parallel traffic can trigger HTTP 429. Respect Chess.com's terms, intellectual property, and caching guidance.

resources.name: Smithsonian Open Access & 3D
resources.description: Millions of Smithsonian collection records, images, and downloadable 3D models of museum objects and specimens.
resources.limitation: Free api.data.gov key required for the API. Only items marked CC0 are open access; check each record's usage status.

resources.name: Poly Haven Assets API
resources.description: CC0 HDRIs, PBR textures, and 3D models with metadata and download links for games, rendering, and visualization.
resources.limitation: Assets are CC0. Identify your app with a unique User-Agent; commercial products using the API should contact Poly Haven and consider supporting it.

resources.name: ambientCG Materials
resources.description: Public-domain PBR materials, HDRIs, and 3D models with a JSON API for searching and downloading assets.
resources.limitation: Assets are CC0 and usable commercially. Avoid excessive automated downloads and cache results where possible.

resources.name: NASA 3D Resources
resources.description: 3D models, textures, and printable files of spacecraft, planets, and mission hardware published by NASA.
resources.limitation: Generally free to use under NASA media guidelines; NASA logos and implied endorsement are restricted.

resources.name: Materials Project API
resources.description: Computed properties of over 150,000 inorganic materials, including crystal structures, band gaps, and elastic data.
resources.limitation: Free account and API key required. Data is CC BY 4.0; cite the Materials Project and respect request rate limits.

resources.name: PubChem PUG-REST
resources.description: Chemical compounds, substances, properties, safety information, and bioassay results from the NIH chemistry database.
resources.limitation: No more than 5 requests per second and 400 per minute; heavy users can be blocked temporarily. Use FTP downloads for bulk data.

resources.name: US Census Bureau Data API
resources.description: Economic census, manufacturing, business patterns, trade, and population statistics for the United States.
resources.limitation: Up to 500 queries per day per IP without a key; a free key is needed for more. Results must not imply Census Bureau endorsement.

resources.name: FRED Economic Data
resources.description: Over 800,000 economic time series including industrial production, manufacturing, prices, and employment.
resources.limitation: Free API key required. Some series are copyrighted by third parties; check series notes and FRED terms before redistribution.

resources.name: arXiv API
resources.description: Search metadata and abstracts for millions of preprints in physics, mathematics, computer science, and more.
resources.limitation: Make no more than one request every three seconds. Metadata is CC0; full papers keep their individual licenses. Credit arXiv per its API terms.

resources.name: Zenodo Research Repository
resources.description: Search and download open research datasets, software, publications, and records deposited by researchers.
resources.limitation: Searching public records needs no token; uploads require an access token. Rate limits apply, and each record has its own license.

resources.name: Europe PMC REST API
resources.description: Life-science literature search with abstracts, open-access full texts, citations, and text-mined annotations.
resources.limitation: Free without registration. Full-text reuse depends on each article's license; use bulk downloads for large text-mining jobs.

resources.name: NCBI PubMed E-utilities
resources.description: Programmatic search and retrieval for PubMed citations and other NCBI biomedical databases.
resources.limitation: Up to 3 requests per second without a key, 10 with a free key. Include tool and email parameters; run large jobs off-peak.

resources.name: Hugging Face Hub API
resources.description: Search and download public AI models, datasets, and demo apps, including model cards and metadata.
resources.limitation: Public repos can be read without a token, but rate limits are stricter. Gated models need an account. Every model and dataset has its own license.

resources.name: OpenML
resources.description: An open machine learning platform with datasets, tasks, algorithms, and benchmark results for reproducible experiments.
resources.limitation: Reading public data needs no key; uploads need a free account key. Check each dataset's license and citation.

resources.name: Kaggle Datasets
resources.description: A large community library of datasets for data science, machine learning, and competitions.
resources.limitation: A free Kaggle account and API token are needed to download. Licenses are set by each uploader and some datasets restrict commercial use.

resources.name: Mozilla Common Voice
resources.description: Crowd-sourced speech recordings with transcripts in many languages for training speech recognition models.
resources.limitation: Released under CC0. You confirm an email address and agree not to try to identify speakers. Downloads are very large.

resources.name: Wikimedia Data Dumps
resources.description: Full downloads of Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects: articles, revisions, and page metadata in many languages.
resources.limitation: Text is mostly CC BY-SA, which means attribution and share-alike. Limit parallel downloads; mirrors are recommended for large jobs.

resources.name: Stack Exchange API
resources.description: Questions, answers, tags, and users from Stack Overflow and the rest of the Stack Exchange network.
resources.limitation: 300 requests per day per IP without a key, about 10,000 with a free app key. Content is CC BY-SA and requires attribution. Follow backoff signals.

resources.name: GitHub REST API
resources.description: Public repositories, issues, releases, contributors, and code metadata from the world's largest code host.
resources.limitation: 60 requests per hour without a token; a free token raises this to 5,000. Each repository keeps its own license.

resources.name: PyPI JSON API
resources.description: Package metadata, versions, release files, and project links for every Python package on PyPI.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Cache responses and avoid heavy polling; use the BigQuery dataset for bulk download statistics.

resources.name: npm Registry API
resources.description: Package documents, versions, dependencies, and search for the JavaScript npm package registry.
resources.limitation: Public reads need no key. Excessive traffic can be rate limited; package licenses vary.

resources.name: deps.dev API
resources.description: Google's open source insights: dependency graphs, licenses, security advisories, and project scores for packages.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Data is CC BY 4.0; the BigQuery dataset is free to access but query costs can apply.

resources.name: Libraries.io API
resources.description: Search open source packages across dozens of package managers, with dependency and repository details.
resources.limitation: Free account API key required; 60 requests per minute. Data is CC BY-SA 4.0.

resources.name: Software Heritage Archive
resources.description: The universal archive of public source code, with browsable history of millions of software projects.
resources.limitation: Anonymous access has low rate limits; a free account token raises them. Archived code keeps its original licenses.

resources.name: Internet Archive APIs
resources.description: Search and download books, audio, video, software, and web collections held by the Internet Archive.
resources.limitation: Free to read. Rights differ per item; uploads need an account. Keep request volume moderate.

resources.name: Wayback Machine API
resources.description: Check whether a web page was archived and retrieve snapshots from the Wayback Machine.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Archived pages keep their original copyright; heavy crawling may be throttled.

resources.name: Europeana APIs
resources.description: Access millions of digitized items from European museums, libraries, and archives.
resources.limitation: Free API key required. Metadata is CC0; each media item carries its own rights statement.

resources.name: Digital Public Library of America
resources.description: Search millions of items from US libraries, archives, and museums through one API.
resources.limitation: Free API key requested by email. Metadata is CC0; linked items keep their providers' rights.

resources.name: Library of Congress API
resources.description: Search Library of Congress collections, including photos, maps, manuscripts, and recordings.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Rate limits apply and exceeding them can block access temporarily; check rights per item.

resources.name: Chronicling America
resources.description: Historic American newspaper pages with OCR text, searchable by title, date, and place.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Mostly public-domain pages; respect Library of Congress rate limits.

resources.name: Art Institute of Chicago API
resources.description: Artworks, artists, exhibitions, and images from the Art Institute of Chicago's collection.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Metadata is CC0; images marked public domain are CC0. Use the data dumps for bulk work.

resources.name: Rijksmuseum Data Services
resources.description: Collection data and high-resolution images from the national museum of the Netherlands.
resources.limitation: Open data with many public-domain images. Access methods changed recently; check current documentation for key requirements.

resources.name: Harvard Art Museums API
resources.description: Objects, people, exhibitions, and images from Harvard's art collections.
resources.limitation: Free API key required; non-commercial use. Image rights vary per object.

resources.name: Project Gutenberg Catalog
resources.description: Catalog data and full texts of more than 70,000 free public-domain ebooks.
resources.limitation: Use the offline catalogs or mirrors instead of scraping the website. Public domain in the US; check laws in your country.

resources.name: Gutendex
resources.description: A simple JSON API for searching Project Gutenberg books by title, author, language, and topic.
resources.limitation: Community-run service without guarantees; you can self-host it for heavy use.

resources.name: DBpedia SPARQL
resources.description: Structured knowledge extracted from Wikipedia, queryable as a linked-data graph.
resources.limitation: Free public endpoint with query time limits. Data is CC BY-SA; use downloads for large workloads.

resources.name: Wikimedia API Portal
resources.description: Page content, summaries, and feeds from Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects.
resources.limitation: Works anonymously with lower limits; a free token raises them. Content is mostly CC BY-SA.

resources.name: ConceptNet
resources.description: A multilingual knowledge graph of common-sense relations between words and phrases.
resources.limitation: CC BY-SA 4.0. The public API is not guaranteed to be online; downloads are more reliable.

resources.name: Princeton WordNet
resources.description: A lexical database of English words grouped into synonyms with meanings and relations.
resources.limitation: Free under the WordNet license, including commercial use, with the copyright notice kept.

resources.name: Free Dictionary API
resources.description: English word definitions, phonetics, examples, and synonyms through a simple API.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Community project without uptime guarantees; please cache results.

resources.name: Datamuse API
resources.description: A word-finding engine for rhymes, similar meanings, autocomplete, and related words.
resources.limitation: No key needed for up to 100,000 requests per day. Credit Datamuse if you use it in an app.

resources.name: Nominatim Geocoding
resources.description: Turn addresses into coordinates and back using OpenStreetMap data.
resources.limitation: Public server: maximum 1 request per second, valid User-Agent, attribution required, no bulk geocoding.

resources.name: Overpass API
resources.description: Query specific OpenStreetMap features such as shops, roads, or buildings in any area.
resources.limitation: Public instances have fair-use limits (about 10,000 queries per day). ODbL attribution applies.

resources.name: GeoNames
resources.description: Place names, postal codes, time zones, and geographic data for millions of locations.
resources.limitation: A free username is required; 10,000 credits per day and 1,000 per hour. Data is CC BY 4.0; paid plans exist.

resources.name: Natural Earth
resources.description: Public-domain map data for countries, borders, rivers, and cities at several scales.
resources.limitation: Public domain; no permission or attribution needed.

resources.name: NASA Earthdata
resources.description: Satellite and Earth science data on climate, land, oceans, and the atmosphere.
resources.limitation: Free Earthdata Login account required for most downloads. NASA data is openly shared; cite datasets.

resources.name: Copernicus Data Space
resources.description: Sentinel satellite images and Earth observation products from the EU's Copernicus programme.
resources.limitation: Free account needed. Data is free and open; processing quotas apply to free users.

resources.name: USGS Water Services
resources.description: Real-time and historical streamflow, groundwater, and water quality from US monitoring sites.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Public domain; keep queries targeted. Services are moving to new USGS water data APIs.

resources.name: JPL Horizons API
resources.description: Positions and orbits of planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and spacecraft.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Run one request at a time; heavy parallel use can be blocked.

resources.name: Launch Library 2
resources.description: Rocket launches, space events, astronauts, and spacecraft data from The Space Devs.
resources.limitation: 15 requests per hour without a key; paid support raises limits.

resources.name: NASA Exoplanet Archive
resources.description: Confirmed planets outside our solar system with orbits, sizes, and host star data.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Cite the archive and the original discovery papers.

resources.name: UniProt
resources.description: Protein sequences and functional information for life-science research.
resources.limitation: No key needed. CC BY 4.0; use streaming or FTP for large downloads.

resources.name: Ensembl REST API
resources.description: Genomes, genes, variants, and comparative genomics for vertebrates and more.
resources.limitation: No key needed; about 15 requests per second. Follow rate-limit headers.

resources.name: RCSB Protein Data Bank
resources.description: 3D structures of proteins, DNA, and other biological molecules with search and data APIs.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Structures are free to use under CC0; cite the PDB entries.

resources.name: ChEMBL
resources.description: Bioactive molecules with drug-like properties and their measured biological activities.
resources.limitation: No key needed. CC BY-SA 3.0; use downloads for full-database work.

resources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov API
resources.description: Registered clinical studies worldwide with status, conditions, locations, and results.
resources.limitation: No key needed; about 50 requests per minute. Not medical advice.

resources.name: WHO Global Health Observatory
resources.description: Health statistics from the World Health Organization on diseases, mortality, and health systems.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Follow WHO terms and cite the source; the API is moving to a new data platform.

resources.name: CDC Open Data
resources.description: Public health datasets from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
resources.limitation: Works without a key with shared limits; a free app token gives more. Read each dataset's notes.

resources.name: UNdata
resources.description: Statistics from United Nations agencies on population, trade, energy, and more.
resources.limitation: Free for non-commercial and commercial use with attribution. Check terms of the underlying agency.

resources.name: ECB Data Portal API
resources.description: Euro area exchange rates, interest rates, money, and banking statistics.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Reuse allowed with source citation.

resources.name: SEC EDGAR APIs
resources.description: US company filings and financial statement data from the Securities and Exchange Commission.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Declare a User-Agent with contact info; maximum 10 requests per second.

resources.name: CoinGecko API
resources.description: Cryptocurrency prices, market data, exchanges, and historical charts.
resources.limitation: Free demo key with monthly call limits and attribution; paid plans for more. Not financial advice.

resources.name: Open Charge Map
resources.description: A global registry of electric vehicle charging locations.
resources.limitation: Free API key required. Data is mostly CC BY 4.0; check data provider licenses.

resources.name: OpenAQ
resources.description: Air quality measurements from government and research sensors worldwide.
resources.limitation: Free API key required; rate limits apply. Each data provider sets its own license.

resources.name: data.europa.eu
resources.description: The official portal for open data from EU institutions and European countries.
resources.limitation: Licenses and formats vary by publisher; check each dataset.

resources.name: Humanitarian Data Exchange
resources.description: Data on crises, population, health, and infrastructure shared by humanitarian organizations.
resources.limitation: Free to browse and download. Licenses vary, and some datasets need approval because they are sensitive.

resources.name: OpenAddresses
resources.description: Free address point data collected from governments around the world.
resources.limitation: Free downloads; each source has its own license and attribution rules.

resources.name: Open Trivia Database
resources.description: Thousands of user-contributed quiz questions across many categories.
resources.limitation: No key needed. CC BY-SA 4.0; one request every 5 seconds per IP.

resources.name: PokéAPI
resources.description: Pokémon species, moves, abilities, types, and games in a detailed open API.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Cache resources locally; Pokémon names and images are owned by their rights holders.

resources.name: TheSportsDB
resources.description: Teams, players, leagues, events, and artwork across many sports.
resources.limitation: A free test key with limited calls; live scores and more need a paid key.

resources.name: Jikan Anime API
resources.description: Unofficial MyAnimeList data for anime, manga, characters, and reviews.
resources.limitation: No key needed. 3 requests per second and 60 per minute; respect MyAnimeList's terms.

resources.name: Nager.Date Holidays
resources.description: Public holidays for more than 100 countries by year.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Open source and community-maintained; self-hosting is possible.

resources.name: Openverse API
resources.description: Search hundreds of millions of openly licensed images and audio files.
resources.limitation: Anonymous use has low limits; register a free client for more. Check each media license.

resources.name: Wikimedia Commons API
resources.description: Free images, video, and audio files with license and author metadata.
resources.limitation: No key needed. Each file has its own free license; give the required attribution.

resources.name: Sensor.Community
resources.description: A citizen-science sensor network reporting particulate matter and noise levels in Germany.
resources.limitation: Open, community-run DIY sensor network; check the site for usage terms.

resources.name: NASA FIRMS
resources.description: Near-real-time satellite detections of active fires and thermal anomalies worldwide.
resources.limitation: NASA public-domain data; an account is required for some tools.

resources.name: Copernicus EFFIS
resources.description: The EU's official wildfire information system tracking fire activity across Europe and beyond.
resources.limitation: Official EU service; free to use.

resources.name: GDACS
resources.description: A United Nations system issuing near-real-time alerts for earthquakes, tsunamis, floods and storms.
resources.limitation: UN service; free to use.

resources.name: Google Flood Hub
resources.description: Machine-learning flood forecasts for rivers in more than 40 countries, from Google Research.
resources.limitation: Google Research service; free to use.

resources.name: Copernicus FFWS
resources.description: The Copernicus global flood early-warning service, showing daily river flood risk worldwide.
resources.limitation: Copernicus service; free with registration.

resources.name: NOAA Tsunami
resources.description: Live tsunami warnings and advisories from the U.S. National Tsunami Warning Center.
resources.limitation: U.S. government data in the public domain.

resources.name: Copernicus Marine
resources.description: Copernicus ocean monitoring data covering currents, sea temperature and sea ice.
resources.limitation: Free with registration.

resources.name: OBIS
resources.description: An open database of marine species occurrence records from oceans worldwide.
resources.limitation: Open data; check the site for terms.

resources.name: BirdCast
resources.description: Live bird-migration forecasts derived from weather radar, run by the Cornell Lab of Ornithology.
resources.limitation: Free, Cornell Lab project; API terms to be clarified.

resources.name: VolcanoDiscovery
resources.description: Live volcano eruption reports with photos and travel advisories.
resources.limitation: Ad-supported site; free to use.

resources.name: Cloudflare Radar
resources.description: Cloudflare's dashboard of global internet traffic, cyberattacks and outages.
resources.limitation: Free; the API requires a login.

resources.name: RIPEstat + Atlas
resources.description: RIPE's platform of worldwide internet measurements and network analytics.
resources.limitation: Free, operated by the non-profit RIPE NCC.

resources.name: IODA
resources.description: A Georgia Tech tool that detects global internet outages in near real time.
resources.limitation: Free, provided by Georgia Tech.

resources.name: OONI Explorer
resources.description: An open archive of OONI network-measurement results showing censorship by provider and country.
resources.limitation: Open-source project with openly published measurement data; quotas to be confirmed.

resources.name: NetBlocks
resources.description: Real-time monitoring and reporting of internet shutdowns and connectivity anomalies.
resources.limitation: Freemium; basic access is free.

resources.name: nPerf Maps
